Business Definition: Signed sales value before discounts, including returns.
Interpretation: Compare with net sales to understand discount funding.
Potential Caveats: Legitimate return reversals remain in scope.

Business Definition: Signed commercial sales after discounts and returns.
Potential Caveats: Covers the selected assortment rather than every retailer product.

Business Definition: Recorded net sales as a share of aligned store-week targets.
Interpretation: Below 100% indicates a gap to management plan.
Potential Caveats: Targets are not allocated to product, category or supplier.

Business Definition: Recorded net sales less cost of goods sold.
Interpretation: Measures the gross commercial contribution of the scoped range.
Potential Caveats: Excludes operating costs and promotional funding adjustments.

Business Definition: Gross profit as a share of recorded net sales.
Interpretation: A declining margin can accompany rising sales.
Potential Caveats: Category and promotion mix affect comparisons.

Business Definition: Recorded discounts as a share of gross sales.
Interpretation: Shows the realised commercial price concession.

Business Definition: Fulfilled tracked demand as a share of expected tracked demand.
Interpretation: Weighting prevents low-volume products from dominating.
Potential Caveats: Only covers the tracked product range; expected demand is modelled.

Business Definition: Difference between observed weighted availability and management target.
Interpretation: Shows percentage-point performance against the reference.
Potential Caveats: A green total can hide weak supplier-region slices.

Business Definition: Capture-adjusted modelled sales missed when tracked demand is unfulfilled.
Interpretation: Sizes the commercial exposure rather than just the shortage rate.
Potential Caveats: Estimated; assumes category-specific demand capture factors.

Business Definition: Capture-adjusted gross profit associated with modelled lost demand.
Interpretation: Shows approximate contribution exposure before intervention costs.
Potential Caveats: Estimated; excludes spoilage, transfers and execution cost.

Business Definition: Received supplier order units as a share of ordered units.
Potential Caveats: Describes observed orders; does not explain why units were short.

Business Definition: Purchase orders received no later than their promised date.
Interpretation: Measures delivery reliability at order grain.
Potential Caveats: An early or on-time order may still be short.

Business Definition: Estimated hours of shelf unavailability within the tracked week.
Potential Caveats: Estimated from the fulfilled-demand ratio and trading-hour assumption.

Business Definition: Share of estimated lost sales explained by the ten highest-loss products.
Formula: Top-10 product estimated lost sales / all tracked estimated lost sales
Interpretation: Identifies whether a targeted product intervention is sensible.
Potential Caveats: Ranking changes with the selected filter scope.

Business Definition: Supplier share of total estimated tracked-range missed sales.
Formula: Supplier estimated lost sales / all supplier estimated lost sales
Potential Caveats: Association should not be treated as proven causation.

Business Definition: Scenario-based portion of modelled missed sales assumed operationally recoverable.
Interpretation: Translates exposure into a cautious discussion scenario.
Potential Caveats: Not a forecast; 58% must be replaced with measured intervention performance.

Business Definition: Scenario-based portion of modelled gross-profit exposure assumed recoverable.
Potential Caveats: Excludes recovery cost, working capital and execution constraints.
